name: Kujūkuri (Japan)
description: A light blue field charged at the centre with the Kujūkuri town emblem in white: a stylised character of diagonal strokes.
history: Municipal flag of Kujūkuri, a town in Chiba Prefecture; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. The municipal emblem was adopted on 10 October 1962.

features.role: Kujūkuri town emblem — a stylised character of diagonal strokes
